summary: Combine admin debug: "show results dialog" button to preview the end-of-run screen without playing a full run.
Combine DetailCard: + separator sits between chips (not inside the left chip), and recipe-chip pictograms show their tier swatch again.
Combine end screen: "New discoveries" tiles now use an inline pill (pictogram + label on one row, tier-coloured mini-tile) instead of pictogram-above-label.
Unify Combine recipe/discoveries chip into one .cbchip primitive with size + flavor modifiers (sm/xs, ghost/muted). Five parallel .cbrcp CSS blocks collapsed.
Combine: age-up now only counts unique first-finds at the current band (T-0051). Soft leaderboard reset at fix date — no backfill of historical Combine `progress` rows.
Combine DetailCard: show the item's kind as a pill under the name (matches item-page style). Only shown for known items.
Combine ages sheet: past ages now show `Done (X/Y)` with the band finds count vs threshold (T-0054).

Combine theme dialog: restart now names the mode × theme explicitly ("Restart Fast · Everyday") and honours Fast (previously silently switched to Endless). Side: subtext in theme dialog shrunk to 11px. (T-0046)
Introduce ButtonGroup component + migrate all action-button rows across Combine, Craft, 404, and shared dialogs. Fixes flush-button misclicks and prevents the pattern from recurring.
Combine move helper uses drag + highlight/tick/cross, matching the main board gesture
Combine audio resumes reliably after tab switch; music + SFX now on by default
Combine Fast mode: allow ≤ 3-part recipes (was pair-only), stop leaking Fast crafts into the lifetime collection, split Fast bests out in the stats panel. (T-0028)

Audited Combine game-state persistence: refresh resume works as designed; in-progress state is localStorage-only; result write trusts clamped client totals (cheatable before public leaderboard ships).
User feedback surface + admin triage (suggest item/recipe, report broken recipe)
Combine DetailCard: "Report this item" entry points the item at the feedback triage queue
Feedback dialog no longer shows raw ids / context block to the user (payload still carries them for admin)
Combine recipe toast: output chip shows pictogram; chip text readable in dark mode (T-0060)
Combine: feedback entry in More menu, DetailCard Report grouped with Back, human-readable "Reporting …" line in dialog
